title: By default, Chinese AI falls very behind
excerpt: This work is hosted on MCNAIR , but does not reflect the views of my employer or the Center. In the last couple of weeks, domestic coordination on mitigating AI risks has looked more likely .

title: Launching Babel Translation
excerpt: Celeste and I are excited to launch Babel Translation , a nonprofit organization translating English-language writing on AI safety to be accessible to a global audience! We’re starting with Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, and Japanese.
